samples.question: Follow the cyan route from the triangular START cap to the round END cap. The START cap sets the current cell: green means dark and pink means light. Read the 50 instruction beads in route order, two at a time: amber means flip the state and navy means hold it. After each pair, write the current state into the next cell of a 5 by 5 grid, left-to-right and top-to-bottom. Which symbol appears: X, plus, T, or L?
